training.features: old/new source distributions, base distribution, old relay distribution, entropy, margin, row token price, graph-change mask
training.target: whether replacing one old relay row prevents a changed finite decision set

interpretation: The learned row selector shows a small cross-task gain at top-1 and a density-panel gain, but no stable interface gain and no consistent same-budget dominance. This is a candidate signal, not ACL-level evidence.
next: Pairwise ranking objective, independent task-flow collection, and end-to-end answer-quality evaluation under matched token budgets.
